en: You cast {11:0001:0041} twice and are hit by {11:0001:0045} twice. What is your current spell resistance boost rate?{w}
"Now then, who dares be the next challenger!?"{w}

note: Reacts to Soara asking for help about the Board Chair (cf. McMahon's 3610 in slice 055). [JP]: honorific not rendered.

en: "Very well, I understand. Then you'd best take my shikigami along with you!"{w}
note: [JP] = shikigami (Kamikaze summons the Inugami in 3369).

en: "Actually, I was hoping you'd come yourself, Professor..."{w}

note: Source opens the quote and never closes it; closed in English (lead convention). Mirco is cut off; 3742 repeats the line in full.
[JP]…… [JP]: shock. Mirco was barged in on behind a locked door (3744).

en: "I locked the door, didn't I!?{w}D-don't come in heeere!!!{w}Waaah! Stupiiid!!!"{w}
note: [JP] rendered without a number so the party size stays open.

en: There is a signpost bearing the Rubenburg crest.{w}

note: Sign banner; framed with * like the source. Check centring in game.
Three-line sign banner. [JP] = 'Completion Exam'; [JP] = 'Magic School' (new). Check centring/width in game.

en: No one is here.{w}...No, you sense a powerful magical force approaching!{w}Space twists, and then...{w}
"Sorry to keep you waiting."{w}{p}"If you've come here, that means you've come to take the Year 3 Completion Exam and the graduation exam, doesn't it?"{w}

note: Prompt, 32 chars; shorten to 'Take the Year 3 Exam?' if the prompt box is tight.

en: "Very well.{w}Face it with everything you've learned at this school -- all of your knowledge."{w}
"...Very good, you pass.{w}You did very well!{w}Now, take your certificate with you."{w}

[Key Item]
You obtained the Year 3 Certificate.{w}
note: Key item [JP] = 'Year 3 Certificate' (new; EBOOT item slot len 15 bytes in JP, relocated text has no budget).

en: "The Principal's office is to the east on this floor.{w}Go there and receive your diploma."{w}{p}"Once you do, you'll have graduated from Rubenburg!!"{w}
note: [JP] = 'diploma' (as in slice 016, 131).

en: "...I'm sorry, but I can't let you graduate just yet.{w}Stay and learn a little more."{w}
"There's no shame in recognizing your own inexperience.{w}Come back once you've properly built up your strength."{w}
note: Likely the reply when the party declines the exam (parallel to Kamikaze's 3686).

en: The moment Vice Principal Kathleen's eyes closed, an anti-cheating barrier went up.{w}
note: Phrased without a pronoun (glossary: Kathleen's gender unknown).

en: What is {11:0001:0015} in the narrow sense?{w}
note: {11:0001:0015} is a spell name (3814/3815 ask which spell is needed to learn it).

en: In the broad sense, how many spells make up {11:0001:0015}?{w}
Which spell should you know before learning {11:0001:0015}?{w}
"How unusual, Soara, for you to raise your voice like that."{w}
"This is about the Board Chair, isn't it?"{w}

"It's been bothering me a little, too.{w}The thing is... unfortunately, my magic isn't strong enough to find out what's going on with the Board Chair."{w}{p}"On top of that, that room is covered by a barrier.{w}No one can get in by ordinary means."{w}

"There is one way. Behind the Principal's office... it seems a path into the Board Chair's office has actually been prepared."{w}{p}"Only the Principal can use it, but I might be able to make it usable for you and your friends too, Soara."{w}
"However, we're up against the Board Chair.{w}Even for me, securing the path will take everything I've got, so..."{w}{p}"Beyond that, it'll be up to all of you.{w}Is that all right?"{w}
"I can hardly turn down a request from one of my dear students...{w}Well then, I'll see you later."{w}
"Thank goodness...{w}The person I can rely on most actually understood..."{w}
note: [JP]: object left implicit (Soara's plea / us); kept as 'understood'.

en: "Hmm... that's strange...{w}Whenever I walk around here, I always feel someone's eyes on me..."{w}
Zapper and Zephal are here.{w}They seem to be surrounded by students...{w}

note: [JP] = Zephal (male per glossary); Zapper is the griffon of the next line.

en: "GRAAAAAAH!!{w}Shut the hell up, you lot!!{w}Touch me any more and I'll eat you!!"{w}

note: Phrased without a pronoun: Zapper's gender is unknown.

en: "Young ladies, have you seen a boy about this tall?"{w}
note: Zephal is looking for Mirco.

en: "Um... i-if you'd have a meal with me, I might just remember!"{w}
"Hey, no sneaking ahead of the rest of us!{w}I saw him too!!{w}If you'd go for a walk with me..."{w}
"Me, me!{w}I saw him too!!{w}M-maybe if you gave me a kiss, I'd remember!?"{w}
"Miss!{w}Have you no modesty, any of you!!"{w}
note: [JP] (singular) then [JP] (plural): kept both.
Whose face is unclear (Zapper just yelled; 'handsome' was used of Zephal, who also scolded them). Kept without a referent.
